description_en: Queries the status of refresh or preload tasks by task ID to verify their completion across the network
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnRefreshTaskById通过任务编号查询刷新或预热是否在全网生效
name: DescribeDcdnRefreshTaskById

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the task to query. To get a task ID, call one of the following operations:

Call the [RefreshDcdnObjectCaches](~~RefreshDcdnObjectCaches~~) operation to obtain the ID of a refresh task.

Call the [PreloadDcdnObjectCaches](~~PreloadDcdnObjectCaches~~) operation to obtain the ID of a preload task.

You can specify up to 10 task IDs in a single request. Separate multiple task IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的任务ID。具体如下：

调用[RefreshDcdnObjectCaches](~~RefreshDcdnObjectCaches~~)接口，获取刷新任务ID。
调用[PreloadDcdnObjectCaches](~~PreloadDcdnObjectCaches~~)接口，获取预热任务ID。

每次调用最多可以传入10个任务ID，多个任务ID用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: task_id

Tasks.description_en: A list of the returned tasks

CreationTime.description_en: The task creation time in UTC, formatted as `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`
CreationTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间。使用UTC时间表示，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Description.description_en:
The error description if the task fails. Valid values:

Internal Error: An internal error occurred.

Origin Timeout: The origin server timed out.

Origin Return StatusCode 5XX: The origin server returned a 5xx status code
Description.description_zh:
刷新或预热失败后返回的错误描述。取值：

Internal Error：内部错误。
Origin Timeout：源站响应超时。
Origin Return StatusCode 5XX：源站响应5xx错误码

ObjectPath.description_en: The path of the refreshed or preloaded object
ObjectPath.description_zh: 刷新或预热对象的路径

ObjectType.description_en:
The type of the refresh or preload task. Valid values:

file: file refresh.

directory: directory refresh.

preload: file preload
ObjectType.description_zh:
刷新或预热任务类型。取值：

file：单文件刷新。

directory：目录刷新。

preload：单文件预热

Process.description_en: The progress of the task as a percentage

Status.description_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

Complete: The task is complete.

Pending: The task is waiting to be processed.

Refreshing: The task is in progress.

Timeout: The task timed out.

Canceled: The task was canceled.

Failed: The task failed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：

Complete：完成。
Pending：等待。
Refreshing：处理中。
Timeout：超时未执行。
Canceled：取消。
Failed：失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of tasks returned
